BEGIN

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 BELL;
 COMMIT;

 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) AND :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'QUERY' THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;

 :title.user_name := :PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME;
 :title.SCREEN_NAME := :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME;
 :title.SYSTEM_DATE := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET VARCHAR2(10);
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN
 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;

IF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 2 THEN
 RET := STR.DISPAlert('يجب ادخال بنود للتعهد او حذف التعهد','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

ELSIF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 0 THEN
 PROP := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('SAVE',VISIBLE);

 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);

END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 if vis = 'TRUE' then
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible, property_false);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 else
 TMPLT.Populate_Functions ;
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 IF vis = 'FALSE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(-1);
END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(1);
END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 Set_Item_Property('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'STD_NORMAL_FUNCTION');
 Execute_Function('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := FALSE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN

 SELECT COUNT(DCLTN_NBR) INTO V_COUNT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;

 IF V_COUNT > 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;
 DECLTN_LOV;

 ELSIF V_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_DT INTO :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;

 END IF;
ELSE
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TYPE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TIR_HEAD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TIR_HQ_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TERMN_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستخدم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جهة الأوضاع الخاصه', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_MNFCT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,MNFCT_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INSPECTOR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم المعاين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_GROUP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_FRIMEX_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_EXIT_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز منفذ الخروج', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_DHLOWN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في مالك بوليصة البريد السريع الدولي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في دولة الوصول النهائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BRKRAUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BKM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم الرخصة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AG_AUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'AGNT_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AGNT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الشركة الوسيطة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AEO_REAS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب اختيار المشغل الأقتصادى - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN

 ;

/* CGFK$QRY_LOOKUP_DATA */
/* Query lookup data for the foreign key(s) */
BEGIN
 IF (name_in('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD') IS NOT NULL OR name_in('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$QRY_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_STATU(
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_NAME /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_NAME. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD ); /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD, 'DCLTN_HDR', STATUS , QUERY_STATUS);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(78, '<p1> must be entered', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 78);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (name_in('DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$QRY_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_PORT_(
 :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_NAME /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_NAME. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD ); /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD, 'DCLTN_HDR', STATUS , QUERY_STATUS);
 END IF;
 IF (name_in('DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD') IS NOT NULL OR name_in('DCLTN_HDR.AGENT_NBR') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$QRY_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_AGNT_(
 :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_ARABIC_NAME /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_ARABIC_NAME. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.AGENT_NBR /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.AGENT_NBR. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD ); /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الشركة الوسيطة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;

/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DCLTN_HDR');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2291_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2291_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2291_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), DCLTN_TYPE_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), DCLTN_TYPE_CD '||'FROM DCLTN_STATUS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

DECLARE

 ,:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.TRAIN_DLVY_VYG_MFST_NBR /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.TRAIN_DLVY_VYG_MFST_NBR. */

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'FC_PORT_GATE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم البوابة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'FC_GATE_SHIFTS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم الوردية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_VHTR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات حركة السيارات - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_SEA_ITEM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات إذن التسليم البحري - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_SEA_DLVY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'تاريخ إذن التسليم,رقم إذن التسليم,وكيل الشحن' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الميناء' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_DCLTN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات البيان الجمركي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_AIR_DLVY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات إذن التسليم الجوي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'الفسح من البوا','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'الفسح من البو','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.TriggerText:

/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2291_GLOBALS.DCLTN_GATE_TRANS_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2291_GLOBALS.DCLTN_GATE_TRANS_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2291_GLOBALS.DCLTN_GATE_TRANS_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.GATE_NAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(GATE_NAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(GATE_NAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(GATE_NAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(GATE_NAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(GATE_NBR), ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(GATE_NBR), ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD '||'FROM PORT_GATES WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SHIFT_NAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SHIFT_NAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SHIFT_NAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SHIFT_NAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SHIFT_NAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(SHIFT_ID), ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(SHIFT_ID), ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD '||'FROM GATE_SHIFTS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(PLATE_NO '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(PLATE_NO '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(PLATE_NO LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(PLATE_NO ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(VHCL_TRANS_DATE), ''CG$NULL''), nvl(to_char(VHCL_TRANS_NBR), ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(TRANS_DATE_H), ''CG$NULL''), nvl(to_char(TRAN_SEQ), ''CG$NULL''),
 PORT_CD '||'FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_CLR_DCLTN BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 1 THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_AIR THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
 CLR_ALL_ADLVY;
-- ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (DCLTN.PT_SEA, DCLTN.PT_DRY) THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
--&&& END
 CLR_ALL_SDLVY;
 CHK_VSSL_BLS;
 ELSE
 NULL;
 END IF;
 V_CLR_DCLTN := TRUE;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 2 THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_AIR THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
--&&& END
 CLR_ADLVY;
 V_CLR_DCLTN := DCLTN_CLRD_AIR;
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (DCLTN.PT_SEA, DCLTN.PT_DRY) THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
--&&& END
 CLR_SDLVY;
 CHK_VSSL_BLS;
 V_CLR_DCLTN := DCLTN_CLRD_SEA;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE IN (3, 5, 6) THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (DCLTN.PT_SEA, DCLTN.PT_DRY) THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
--&&& END
 CLR_SITEM;
 CHK_VSSL_BLS;
 V_CLR_DCLTN := DCLTN_CLRD_SEA;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 1 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 5, 3, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN||'!'||:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 2 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 5, 2, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN||'!'||:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 3 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 5, 1, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN||'!'||:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 5 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 5, 4, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN||'!'||:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 6 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 5, 5, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN||'!'||:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 ADJ_FUNS;

 IF V_CLR_DCLTN = TRUE THEN
 CLR_DCLTN;
 END IF;
END;

----------------------------------------------------------------
--XRAY CHECK
--DESCRIPTION : NEW UPDATES FOR XRAY
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARAF
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 13/05/2005
----------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE
 V_WT NUMBER;
 V_PKG NUMBER;
 V_CNT_MRK VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_RET VARCHAR(100);

BEGIN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD <> DCLTN.DSI_2REL THEN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_2REL') THEN
--&&& END
 STR.DISPALERT('حالة البيان لا تسمح بفسحه', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF EXIST_STRG_FEES THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 2 THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_AIR THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
--&&& END
 IF CAN_CLR_ADLVY = FALSE THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (DCLTN.PT_SEA, DCLTN.PT_DRY) THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
--&&& END
 IF CAN_CLR_SDLVY = FALSE THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE IN (3, 5, 6) THEN
 IF CAN_CLR_SITEM = FALSE THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 GET_SITEM_REMAINS(V_WT, V_PKG);
 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRD_WT > V_WT THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الوزن أكبر من المسموح بفسحه', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRD_QTY > V_PKG THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الكمية أكبر من المسموح بفسحها', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRD_WT = V_WT AND :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRD_QTY < V_PKG) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('تم فسح الوزن بالكامل - ولم تفسح الكمية بالكامل', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRD_WT < V_WT AND :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRD_QTY = V_PKG) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('تم فسح الكمية بالكامل - ولم يفسح الوزن بالكامل', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

 ELSIF (:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRD_QTY = 0) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الكمية المفسوحة تساوى صفر ', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRD_WT = 0) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الوزن المفسوح يساوى صفر ', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_SEA THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA') THEN
--&&& END
 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SHIFT_ID IS NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SHIFT_ID := GET_SHIFT_ID(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SHIFT_NAME);
 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SHIFT_ID IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن الحصول على رقم النوبة', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;


---------------------------------------------------------
-- BY SHERIFT UPON HESHAM & AHASAN REQUEST TO CHECK ON XRAY CNTNR 13/05/1426--
 V_CNT_MRK := NULL;
 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 1 THEN
 V_CNT_MRK :=XRAY_CHK_DCLN(:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN);
 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 2 THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
 NULL;
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
 V_CNT_MRK :=XRAY_CHK_SDO(:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT,:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN);
 END IF;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE =3 THEN
 V_CNT_MRK :=XRAY_CHK_SDI(:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT,:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ,:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN);
 END IF;
 IF V_CNT_MRK IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_CNT_MRK := CHR(1000) || V_CNT_MRK;
 V_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_CNT_MRK, 'INFORMATION', 1, 'قائمة الحاويات التي لا تزال في الفحص بالإشعة',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1300, 'r255g0b0', 12);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

BEGIN
 SELECT MAX(DGT_SEQ)+1

 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE PRINT_REPORT(FN In VARCHAR2, PL_ID PARAMLIST, V_REP_FRM_FLG NUMBER, V_REP_PRNT_FLG NUMBER) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;


 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
/*
 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;
*/
 BEGIN
/* IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 6
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);

 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_REP_FRM_FLG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF V_REP_PRNT_FLG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 rep.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 rep.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('مسار ملف التقرير غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('ملف التقرير غير معرف داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;*/

 NIB.PRINT_REPORT(FN,PL_ID,V_REP_FRM_FLG,V_REP_PRNT_FLG);
 END PRINT_REPORT;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXECUTE_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE Execute_Function(FN In VARCHAR2) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;
 CD_TITLE VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 CD_TITLE := NAME_IN(FN);

 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).TITLE LIKE CD_TITLE AND TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).ACT = 1 THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);
 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_SYS_TYPE = 5 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ ||'-'||V_SEQ_NO);
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).FORM_FLAG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PRNT_FLAG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'TMPLT_MOD_CALL'||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END Execute_Function;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 14/05/2026 03:55:11 ? (QP5 v5.287) */
FUNCTION CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID (V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_USER_ID VARCHAR2)
 RETURN BOOLEAN
IS
 V_ROLE_ID VARCHAR2 (30);
 V_RETURN BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 /*BEGIN
 SELECT UR.ROLE_ID INTO V_ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES UR
 WHERE UR.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND UR.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UR.UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND UR.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 UNION
 SELECT GR.ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES GR, SC_USER_GROUPS UG
 WHERE UG.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UG.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND GR.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 AND GR.GROUP_ID = UG.GROUP_ID
 AND GR.GR_ACTIVE = 1
 MINUS
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES UER
 WHERE UER.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND UER.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UER.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'

 ;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
PROCEDURE CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS IS
/* Read each lists values from its record group and populate the list */
 temp NUMBER; /* Return value of populate_group call */
 rg_id RECORDGROUP; /* Return value of populate_group call */
BEGIN
 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DCLTN_PMT_METHOD'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DLVY_TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DLVY_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''MANIFEST TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_MFST_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''SHPMT TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_SHPMT_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''MFST_TYPES'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_MFST_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTNT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_BUSID_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VHTR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'Trans Date H,Tran Seq,رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDO_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'تاريخ اصدار الأذن,رقم وكيل الشحن,رقم اذن' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BO_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رقم المالك,جمرك التسجيل,رقم المانفيست,نو' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SHAG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رقم وكيل الشحن' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SHAG_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', '' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SVM_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ,رقم المانفيست,تاريخ المانفيست' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VM_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('سبق تسجيل مانفيست لنفس الباخرة في نفس اليوم..تأكد من البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VM_ARVL_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('سبق تسجيل مانفيست لنفس الباخرة في نفس اليوم..تأكد من البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هل السجل مدخل مسبقاً - أعد إدخال سجل جديد', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(' لا يمكن إصدار إذن تسليم جديد - يوجد إذن تسليم لهذا الجزء من البوليصة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_DTL_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هل السجل مدخل مسبقاً - أعد إدخال سجل جديد', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هل السجل مدخل مسبقاً - أعد إدخال سجل جديد', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'GS_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'Shift Id,رمز المنفذ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'PG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ,Gate Nbr' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDI_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'مسلسل الصنف على اذن التسليم,جمرك التسجيل' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VBI_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'المسلسل بالبوليصة,مسلسل البوليصة,رمز الم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VB_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'مسلسل البوليصة,رمز المنفذ,رقم المانفيست,' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VB_BL_NBR_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('لا يمكن تكرار الرقم الأصلي للبوليصة على نفس المانفيست', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SVC_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'جمرك التسجيل,نوع المانفيست,رقم المانفيست' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SVCNTNR_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('عفوا..سبق تسجيل نفس العلامة المميزة للحاوية على نفس المانفيست', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VALID_DATE_NUMBER') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في عملية ترقيم البيان الجمركي - يجب وجود رقم وتاريخ في نفس الوقت', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$TOGGLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$TOGGLE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Toggle query mode between BSMON and BSMOFF, set all query mode items, */
/* display query mode message, set the relations and ensure that the */
/* canvas is coordinated. */
BEGIN
 /* Toggle the mode */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE != 'A') THEN
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 ELSE
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 END IF;
 /* Set all the items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Display query mode messages */
 CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the relations */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* If the query mode is AutoQuery, coordinate outstanding blocks */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 CGBS$.COORD_VISIBLE_BLKS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK );
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Send a message to the status line indicating the current query mode */
BEGIN
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('Auto-query mode on', 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('Auto-query mode off', 'I', 'OFG', 0);

 NULL;

 NULL;

 NULL;

 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF NOT V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := 'حاويات لا تزال في مرحلة الفحص بالإشعة ' || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK;

 END IF;


 IF V_CNTNR_MARK2 IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK2;
 END IF;
 RETURN V_CNTNR_MARK;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN NULL;
END;

 (VSCNIN.PORT_CD, VSCNIN.MFST_TYPE, VSCNIN.MFST_NBR, VSCNIN.MFST_DT, VSCNIN.CNTNR_SEQ,VSCNIN.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ) IN
 (
 SELECT VCI.PORT_CD, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.CNTNR_SEQ , VCI.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS AD ,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI ,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI ,
 VSSL_CNTNRS VSS_CNT ,
 VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VCI
 WHERE ( (AD.PORT_CD = SDI.PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_NBR = SDI.DO_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_ISS_DT = SDI.DO_ISS_DT )
 --
 --
 AND (VBI.PORT_CD = SDI.MFST_PORT_CD )
 AND (VBI.MFST_TYPE = SDI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VBI.MFST_NBR = SDI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VBI.MFST_DT = SDI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VBI.BL_SEQ = SDI.BL_SEQ )
 AND (VBI.ITEM_SEQ = SDI.ITEM_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VBI.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VCI.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VCI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VCI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VCI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VCI.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (AD.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN )
 AND (VCI.INSPCT_ACTN_CD= 2 ) -- معاينة يدوية--
 )
 --GROUP BY VCI.CNTNR_SEQ, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.PORT_CD
 );
 V_CNTNR_MARK VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_RET BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 V_RET :=TRUE;
 V_CNTNR_MARK :=NULL;
 FOR REC IN DCLTN_CNTR_INSP LOOP
 -- BY SHERIFT @KAS
 IF REC.CNTNR_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND DCLTN_CNTR_INSP%FOUND THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VSCNIN
 WHERE (VSCNIN.INSPCT_STA_CD <> 2)
 AND VSCNIN.PORT_CD = REC.PORT_CD
 AND VSCNIN.MFST_TYPE = REC.MFST_TYPE
 AND VSCNIN.MFST_NBR = REC.MFST_NBR
 AND VSCNIN.MFST_DT = REC.MFST_DT
 AND VSCNIN.CNTNR_SEQ = REC.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND VSCNIN.INSPCT_ACTN_CD =4
 --AND VSCNIN.INSPCT_RESULT_CD IN (1,3)
 ;
 IF V_COUNT=0 THEN
 V_RET :=FALSE;
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK IS NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := GET_CNTNR_MARK(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ );
 ELSE
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10) || GET_CNTNR_MARK(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ );
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF NOT V_RET THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := 'حاويات تتطلب تأكيد نتيجة فحصها يدويا' || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK;
 END IF;
 RETURN V_CNTNR_MARK;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: XRAY_CHK_DCLN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
----------------------------------------------------------------
--XRAY_CHK_DCLN
--DESCRIPTION : XRAY_CHK_DCLN FOR DCLTN
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARAF
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 13/05/2005
----------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION XRAY_CHK_DCLN(V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 CURSOR DCLTN_CNTR_INSP IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VSCNIN
 WHERE (VSCNIN.INSPCT_STA_CD <> 2) AND
 (VSCNIN.PORT_CD, VSCNIN.MFST_TYPE, VSCNIN.MFST_NBR, VSCNIN.MFST_DT, VSCNIN.CNTNR_SEQ,VSCNIN.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ) IN
 (
 SELECT VCI.PORT_CD, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.CNTNR_SEQ , MAX (VCI.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ)
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS AD ,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI ,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI ,
 VSSL_CNTNRS VSS_CNT ,
 VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VCI
 WHERE ( (AD.PORT_CD = SDI.PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_NBR = SDI.DO_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_ISS_DT = SDI.DO_ISS_DT )
 --
 --
 AND (VBI.PORT_CD = SDI.MFST_PORT_CD )
 AND (VBI.MFST_TYPE = SDI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VBI.MFST_NBR = SDI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VBI.MFST_DT = SDI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VBI.BL_SEQ = SDI.BL_SEQ )
 AND (VBI.ITEM_SEQ = SDI.ITEM_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VBI.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VCI.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VCI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VCI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VCI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VCI.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (AD.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN )
 )
 GROUP BY VCI.CNTNR_SEQ, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.PORT_CD
 );

 V_CNTNR_MARK VARCHAR2(4000);
 V_CNTNR_MARK2 VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_CNTNR_MARK3 VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_CNT_MRK VARCHAR2(20);
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP BOOLEAN;
 V_TST_REC BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP := TRUE;
 V_CNTNR_MARK := NULL;

 FOR REC IN DCLTN_CNTR_INSP LOOP
 V_TST_REC := TRUE;
 -- BY SHERIFT UPON A.HASAN --
 IF REC.INSPCT_ACTN_CD IN (1,2,3,4) THEN
 IF NOT (REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 1 OR REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 3) THEN -- حالة أن نتيجة الفحص سليمة يمكن فسحها أو سليمة سحب عينات --
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP := FALSE ;
 V_TST_REC := FALSE;
 IF REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 0 OR REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 4 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 IF REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 2 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE -- REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 5 --
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- حالة دخول الحاوية فقط و لم تفحص بعد--
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP := FALSE ;
 V_TST_REC := FALSE;
 END IF;
 IF NOT V_TST_REC THEN
 V_CNT_MRK :=GET_CNTNR_MARK(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ );
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK IS NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNT_MRK;
 ELSE
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10)|| V_CNT_MRK;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- TO CHK CONFIRM OR NOT BY SHERIFT 09/10/2005 --
 IF XRAY_CHK_CNTNR_CNFRM(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ )=0 THEN
 V_CNT_MRK :=GET_CNTNR_MARK(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ );
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK3 IS NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK3 := V_CNT_MRK;
 ELSE
 V_CNTNR_MARK3 := V_CNTNR_MARK3 || CHR(10)|| V_CNT_MRK;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- --
 END LOOP;
 V_CNTNR_MARK2 := XRAY_CHK_DCLN2(V_DCLTN_ISN );
 IF NOT V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := 'حاويات لا تزال في مرحلة الفحص بالإشعة ' || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK;
 END IF;
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK3 IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK3 := 'حاويات تحتاج الى تأكيد نتيجة فحص ' || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK3;
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK3;
 END IF;
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK2 IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK2;
 END IF;
 RETURN V_CNTNR_MARK;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN NULL;
END;

FUNCTION XRAY_CHK_CNTNR_CNFRM(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_MFST_TYPE NUMBER,V_MFST_NBR NUMBER,V_MFST_DT DATE,V_CNTNR_SEQ NUMBER)
 RETURN INTEGER IS
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD1 NUMBER;
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD2 NUMBER;
 I NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER:=0;
 V_XRAY_CNFRM_USR_EXIST VARCHAR2(50);

 CURSOR vci_crsr1 IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_PORT_CD, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = V_CNTNR_SEQ
 AND INSPCT_ACTN_CD=1;

 CURSOR vci_crsr2 IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_PORT_CD, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = V_CNTNR_SEQ
 AND INSPCT_ACTN_CD=3
 ORDER BY INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ;
BEGIN

 IF :GLOBAL.XRAY_CNFRM_USR_EXIST ='Y' THEN
 FOR REC IN vci_crsr1 LOOP
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD1 := REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD;
 END LOOP;
 I :=0;
 FOR REC2 IN vci_crsr2 LOOP
 I := I+1;
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD2 := REC2.INSPCT_RESULT_CD;
 IF V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD1 = V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD2 AND I=1 THEN
 RET :=1;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF RET = 0 AND I>1 THEN
 RET :=1;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET :=1;
 END IF;
 RETURN RET;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TIME_TO_NUMBER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION TIME_TO_NUMBER(V_DT DATE) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_RET NUMBER := NULL;
BEGIN
 IF V_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_RET := (TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(V_DT, 'HH24')) * 60) + TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(V_DT, 'MI'));
 END IF;

 RETURN (V_RET);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LINK_WITH_VHTR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION LINK_WITH_VHTR RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_VAR_VALUE VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN
 V_VAR_VALUE := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('LINK_WITH_VHTR',21);

 IF V_VAR_VALUE = '1' THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 END IF;

 -- TO FORCE LINKING WITH A CAR IF THIS IS A CROSSING DECLARATION 10-08-1428
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_LND') AND
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1, 2) AND
 NVL(:DCLTN_HDR.FINAL_CTRY_CD, 100) <> 100 THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 END IF;

 RETURN(FALSE);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_VHTR_OK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_VHTR_OK(V_PORT_CD IN NUMBER, V_TRAN_SEQ IN NUMBER, V_TRANS_DATE_H IN DATE,
 V_TRAN_DRCTN IN NUMBER, V_VHCL_TRAN_TYPE IN NUMBER, V_PSNGR_CARG IN NUMBER,
 V_PLATE_CTRY_CD IN NUMBER, V_ERR_MSG OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
BEGIN
 V_ERR_MSG := NULL;

 IF V_TRAN_DRCTN = 1 THEN -- خروج
 V_ERR_MSG := 'خطأ - أخر قيد حركة لهذه اللوحة هو قيد خروج. يجب تسجيل حركة دخول';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 IF V_PSNGR_CARG = 1 THEN -- ركاب
 V_ERR_MSG := 'خطأ - أخر قيد حركة لهذه اللوحة هو قيد دخول ركاب. يجب تسجيل حركة دخول شحن';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 IF V_VHCL_TRAN_TYPE = 5 THEN -- ترسيم مملكة
 NULL;
 ELSIF V_VHCL_TRAN_TYPE = 15 THEN -- نقل بضاعة من الجمرك
/*
 IF V_PLATE_CTRY_CD <> 100 THEN
 V_ERR_MSG := 'خطأ - لوحة غير سعودية لها قيد دخول نوعه نقل بضاعة من الجمرك';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
*/
 NULL;
 ELSE
 V_ERR_MSG := 'خطأ في نوع الحركة لقيد دخول هذه اللوحة';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 IF V_TRANS_DATE_H <> HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE THEN
 V_ERR_MSG := 'قيد الحركة ليس بتاريخ اليوم';
 END IF;

 DECLARE
 V_DCLTN_NBR NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CLRNC_DT DATE;
 BEGIN
 SELECT D.DCLTN_NBR, D.DCLTN_DT, DT.TYPE_NAME, DGT.CLRNC_DT
 INTO V_DCLTN_NBR, V_DCLTN_DT, V_TYPE_NAME, V_CLRNC_DT
 FROM DECLARATIONS D, DCLTN_TYPES DT, DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 WHERE DT.TYPE_ID = D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND D.PORT_CD = DGT.PORT_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN = DGT.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR = V_TRAN_SEQ
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE = V_TRANS_DATE_H
 AND ROWNUM = 1
 ORDER BY DGT.CLRNC_DT DESC
 ;
 IF V_ERR_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || CHR(13);
 END IF;
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || 'قيد الحركة مربوط على فسح بتاريخ ';
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || TO_CHAR(V_CLRNC_DT, 'MI-MM-YYYY');
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || ' ل';
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || V_TYPE_NAME;
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || ' رقم ';
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || V_DCLTN_NBR;
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || ' وتاريخ ';
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || TO_CHAR(V_DCLTN_DT, 'MI-MM-YYYY');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 RETURN 1;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_VSSL_BLS_CLRD_WT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
UPDATE GET_VSSL_BLS_CLRD_WT()
DESCRIPTION: take Statistical Declaration into consideration
PROGRAMMER : Hesham
VERSION : 1
DATE : 2-2-2005
*/
FUNCTION GET_VSSL_BLS_CLRD_WT(BLS_REC VSSL_BLS%ROWTYPE) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_TOT_WT NUMBER := 0;
 V_SDI_WT NUMBER;
 CURSOR CR_SDI IS SELECT SDI.*
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI, VSSL_BLS B
 WHERE B.PORT_CD = BLS_REC.PORT_CD
 AND B.MFST_TYPE = BLS_REC.MFST_TYPE
 AND B.MFST_DT = BLS_REC.MFST_DT
 AND B.MFST_NBR = BLS_REC.MFST_NBR
 AND B.BL_SEQ = BLS_REC.BL_SEQ
 AND SDI.MFST_PORT_CD = B.PORT_CD
 AND SDI.MFST_TYPE = B.MFST_TYPE
 AND SDI.MFST_DT = B.MFST_DT
 AND SDI.MFST_NBR = B.MFST_NBR
 AND SDI.BL_SEQ = B.BL_SEQ
 ;
 SDI_REC SEA_DLVY_ITEMS%ROWTYPE;
 SDO_REC SEA_DLVY_ORDERS%ROWTYPE;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_STA NUMBER;
BEGIN
 OPEN CR_SDI;
 LOOP
 FETCH CR_SDI INTO SDI_REC;
 EXIT WHEN CR_SDI%NOTFOUND;

 SELECT *
 INTO SDO_REC
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = SDI_REC.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDI_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = SDI_REC.DO_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = SDI_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 ;

 IF SDO_REC.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = SDO_REC.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = SDO_REC.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT_TYPE = 1
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) <> 0 THEN
 V_TOT_WT := V_TOT_WT + SDI_REC.DLVRD_WT;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = SDO_REC.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = SDO_REC.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 AND DGT_TYPE = 2
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) <> 0 THEN
 V_TOT_WT := V_TOT_WT + SDI_REC.DLVRD_WT;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(CLRD_WT)
 INTO V_SDI_WT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = SDO_REC.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = SDO_REC.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ = SDI_REC.PRCSD_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DGT_TYPE IN (3, 5, 6)
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_SDI_WT := 0;
 END;

 V_TOT_WT := V_TOT_WT + NVL(V_SDI_WT, 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF SDO_REC.STATS_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT STATS_STATUS
 INTO V_STA
 FROM STATS_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = SDO_REC.PORT_CD
 AND STATS_ISN = SDO_REC.STATS_DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 IF V_STA = 7 THEN
 V_TOT_WT := V_TOT_WT + SDI_REC.DLVRD_WT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE CR_SDI;

 RETURN(V_TOT_WT);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_VHTR_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_VHTR_DATA IS
 CURSOR C(P_PLATE VARCHAR2, P_CTRY NUMBER, P_CITY NUMBER) IS SELECT PORT_CD, TRAN_SEQ, TRANS_DATE_H, TRAN_DRCTN,
 VHCL_TRAN_TYPE, PSNGR_CARG, PLATE_CTRY_CD
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VHTR
 WHERE VHTR.PLATE_NO = P_PLATE
 AND (VHTR.PLATE_CTRY_CD = P_CTRY OR P_CTRY IS NULL)
 AND (VHTR.PLATE_CITY_CD = P_CITY OR P_CITY IS NULL)
 AND VHTR.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 ORDER BY VHTR.TRANS_DATE_H DESC, VHTR.TRAN_SEQ DESC
 ;
 C_REC C%ROWTYPE;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000) := NULL;
 V_RET VARCHAR(100);
 V_CHK NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR := NULL;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE := NULL;

 OPEN C(:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO, NULL, NULL);
 FETCH C INTO C_REC;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ - لا يوجد قيد حركة لهذه اللوحة. يجب تسجيل حركة دخول', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;

 V_CHK := IS_VHTR_OK(C_REC.PORT_CD, C_REC.TRAN_SEQ, C_REC.TRANS_DATE_H, C_REC.TRAN_DRCTN,
 C_REC.VHCL_TRAN_TYPE, C_REC.PSNGR_CARG, C_REC.PLATE_CTRY_CD, V_MSG);
 IF V_CHK = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 IF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_MSG := V_MSG || CHR(13) || 'هل تريد الاستمرار؟';
 V_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG, 'WARNING', 1);
 IF V_RET <> ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR := C_REC.TRAN_SEQ;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE := C_REC.TRANS_DATE_H;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_SITEM_REMAINS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_SITEM_REMAINS(V_WT OUT NUMBER, V_PKG OUT NUMBER) IS
 V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_DGT_WT NUMBER;
 V_SDI_WT NUMBER;
 V_DGT_PKG NUMBER;
 V_SDI_PKG NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_WT := NULL;
 V_PKG := NULL;

 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT DLVRD_WT, DLVRD_QTY
 INTO V_SDI_WT, V_SDI_PKG
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 AND PRCSD_ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN;
 END;

 V_SDI_WT := NVL(V_SDI_WT , 0);
 V_SDI_PKG := NVL(V_SDI_PKG, 0);

 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN
 INTO V_DCLTN_ISN
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_WT := V_SDI_WT;
 V_PKG := V_SDI_PKG;
 RETURN;
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT_TYPE = 1
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) <> 0 THEN
 V_WT := 0;
 V_PKG := 0;
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 AND DGT_TYPE = 2
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) <> 0 THEN
 V_WT := 0;
 V_PKG := 0;
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(CLRD_WT), SUM(CLRD_QTY)
 INTO V_DGT_WT, V_DGT_PKG
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DGT_TYPE IN (3, 5, 6)
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_DGT_WT := 0;
 V_DGT_PKG := 0;
 END;
 V_DGT_WT := NVL(V_DGT_WT , 0);
 V_DGT_PKG := NVL(V_DGT_PKG, 0);

 V_WT := V_SDI_WT - V_DGT_WT;
 V_PKG := V_SDI_PKG - V_DGT_PKG;

 IF V_WT < 0 THEN
 V_WT := 0;
 END IF;

 IF V_PKG < 0 THEN
 V_PKG := 0;
 END IF;

 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_SHIFT_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_SHIFT_ID(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_SHIFT_NAME OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 CURSOR CR_SHIFT(V_DATE DATE) IS SELECT *
 FROM GATE_SHIFTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND TO_CHAR(SHIFT_SDATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI') <= TO_CHAR(V_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI')
 ORDER BY SHIFT_STIME DESC
 ;
 V_TODAY DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 SHIFT_REC GATE_SHIFTS%ROWTYPE;
 V_NOW NUMBER;
 V_START NUMBER;
 V_END NUMBER;
 V_FOUND BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
 V_NOW := TIME_TO_NUMBER(SYSDATE);
 OPEN CR_SHIFT(V_TODAY);
 LOOP
 FETCH CR_SHIFT INTO SHIFT_REC;
 EXIT WHEN CR_SHIFT%NOTFOUND;

 V_START := TIME_TO_NUMBER(SHIFT_REC.SHIFT_STIME);
 V_END := TIME_TO_NUMBER(SHIFT_REC.SHIFT_ETIME);

 IF V_START < V_END THEN
 IF V_NOW >= V_START AND V_NOW <= V_END THEN
 V_FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF V_START > V_END THEN
 IF NOT(V_NOW > V_END AND V_NOW < V_START) THEN
 V_FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_FOUND = TRUE THEN
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE CR_SHIFT;

 IF V_FOUND = FALSE THEN
 V_SHIFT_NAME := NULL;
 RETURN(NULL);
 END IF;

 V_SHIFT_NAME := SHIFT_REC.SHIFT_NAME;
 RETURN(SHIFT_REC.SHIFT_ID);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_GATE_NBR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_GATE_NBR RETURN NUMBER IS
 HFILE TEXT_IO.FILE_TYPE;
 V_FILENAME VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_LINE VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_GATE_NBR NUMBER;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT VAR_VALUE
 INTO V_FILENAME
 FROM SC_PORT_SETTING
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 999
 AND VAR_NAME = 'GATE_FILENAME'
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN(NULL);
 END;

 BEGIN
 HFILE := TEXT_IO.FOPEN(V_FILENAME, 'R');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN(NULL);
 END;

 BEGIN
 TEXT_IO.GET_LINE(HFILE, V_LINE);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 TEXT_IO.FCLOSE(HFILE);
 RETURN(NULL);
 END;

 TEXT_IO.FCLOSE(HFILE);
 V_GATE_NBR := TO_NUMBER(V_LINE);
 RETURN(V_GATE_NBR);

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN(NULL);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FLASH_CLR_ALERT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION FLASH_CLR_ALERT (
 V_MESS_TXT IN VARCHAR2,
 V_ALERT_TYPE IN VARCHAR2 := 'WARNING',
 V_ALERT_BUT_DEF IN NUMBER := 2,
 V_W_TITLE IN VARCHAR2 := 'رسالة تحذيرية',
 V_W_WIDTH IN NUMBER := 5.5,
 V_W_X_POS IN NUMBER := 1.8,
 V_W_Y_POS IN NUMBER := 2.5,
 V_MESS_X_POS IN NUMBER := 0.5,
 V_FONT_SIZE IN NUMBER := 1300,
 V_FG_COLOR IN VARCHAR2 := 'r255g0b0',
 V_BG_COLOR IN VARCHAR2 := 'r255g255b255',
 V_ROW_COUNT IN NUMBER := 1 ,
 V_BLNKING IN VARCHAR2 := 0

 )RETURN VARCHAR IS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'PLATE_NO_PARAM';
 RET NUMBER;
 COUNT1 NUMBER;
 ALERT_TYPE VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 --ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ALERT_TYPE := UPPER(V_ALERT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_W_TITLE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_W_WIDTH);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_W_X_POS);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_W_Y_POS);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_MESS_TXT' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MESS_TXT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_MESS_X_POS' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MESS_X_POS);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_FONT_SIZE' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_FONT_SIZE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_FG_COLOR' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_FG_COLOR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_BG_COLOR' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_BG_COLOR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_ROW_COUNT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_ALERT_BUT_DEF' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_ALERT_BUT_DEF);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_ALERT_TYPE' , TEXT_PARAMETER,ALERT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_BLNKING' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_BLNKING);


 CALL_FORM('Cic_clr_MESS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 -- ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;


 IF NAME_IN(':GLOBAL.OK') = 1 THEN
 ERASE('GLOBAL.OK');
 RETURN ALERT_BUTTON1;
 ELSE
 ERASE('GLOBAL.OK');
 RETURN ALERT_BUTTON2;
 END IF;

END ;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXTRACT_SEQ
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION EXTRACT_SEQ(V_REMAIN_SEL IN OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_SEQ NUMBER := NULL;
 V_COMMA NUMBER;
 V_SEQ_TXT VARCHAR2(100);
BEGIN
 IF V_REMAIN_SEL IS NULL THEN
 RETURN(NULL);
 END IF;


 V_COMMA := INSTR(V_REMAIN_SEL, ',');
 IF V_COMMA > 0 THEN
 V_SEQ := TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(V_REMAIN_SEL, 1, V_COMMA - 1));
 V_REMAIN_SEL := SUBSTR(V_REMAIN_SEL, V_COMMA + 1);
 ELSE
 V_SEQ := TO_NUMBER(V_REMAIN_SEL);
 V_REMAIN_SEL := NULL;
 END IF;
 RETURN(V_SEQ);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXIST_STRG_FEES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION EXIST_STRG_FEES RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 RET_TOT_STRG_FEES NUMBER := 0;
 RET_ADD_STRG_FEES NUMBER := 0;
 RET_ADD_ORG_STRG_FEES NUMBER := 0;
 RET_TOT_HAND_FEES NUMBER := 0;
 RET_ADD_HAND_FEES NUMBER := 0;
 V_STRG_RET NUMBER := 0;
 V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
/*V_STRG_RET := STRG.GET_DCLTN_STRG_FEES(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN, FALSE,
 RET_TOT_STRG_FEES, RET_ADD_STRG_FEES, RET_TOT_HAND_FEES, RET_ADD_HAND_FEES, RET_ADD_ORG_STRG_FEES);*/
 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 V_STRG_RET := STRG.GET_DCLTN_STRG_FEES(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN, 0,
 RET_TOT_STRG_FEES, RET_ADD_STRG_FEES, RET_TOT_HAND_FEES, RET_ADD_HAND_FEES, RET_ADD_ORG_STRG_FEES,
 V_MSG_TXT, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID, HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE);
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
--&&& END
 IF V_STRG_RET = -1 THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
--&&& END
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن فسح المعاملة الجمركية - لا يمكن حساب أرضيات المعاملة - راجع قسم الحاسب الآلي','ERROR');
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;

 IF (RET_ADD_STRG_FEES + RET_ADD_ORG_STRG_FEES) <> 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن فسح المعاملة الجمركية - توجد أرضيات مستحقة الدفع - راجع وحدة فسح الجمرك','ERROR');
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;

 RETURN FALSE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DCLTN_CLRD_SEA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION DCLTN_CLRD_SEA RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 CURSOR CR_SDO IS SELECT *
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 SDO_REC SEA_DLVY_ORDERS%ROWTYPE;
 V_RET BOOLEAN := TRUE;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_DGT_SUM NUMBER;
 V_SDO_SUM NUMBER;
BEGIN
 OPEN CR_SDO;
 LOOP
 FETCH CR_SDO INTO SDO_REC;
 EXIT WHEN CR_SDO%NOTFOUND;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ IS NULL
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) = 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(CLRD_WT)
 INTO V_DGT_SUM
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_DGT_SUM := 0;
 END;
 V_DGT_SUM := NVL(V_DGT_SUM, 0);

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(DLVRD_WT)
 INTO V_SDO_SUM
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_SDO_SUM := 0;
 END;
 V_SDO_SUM := NVL(V_SDO_SUM, 0);

 IF V_DGT_SUM <> V_SDO_SUM THEN
 V_RET := FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_RET = FALSE THEN
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE CR_SDO;

 RETURN(V_RET);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CREATE_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CREATE_ITEMS(V_SEL VARCHAR2) IS
 V_PLATE_NO VARCHAR2(50) := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO;
 V_VTRAN_NBR NUMBER := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR;
 V_VTRAN_DT DATE := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE;
 V_NOTE VARCHAR2(2000) := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRNC_NOTE;
 V_SDLVY_NBR NUMBER := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR;
 V_SDLVY_DT DATE := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT;
 V_AGENT_NBR NUMBER := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR;
 V_DGT_TYPE NUMBER := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE;
 V_FIRST_REC BOOLEAN := TRUE;
 V_REMAIN_SEL VARCHAR2(2000) := V_SEL;
 V_SEQ NUMBER;
BEGIN
 LOOP
 V_SEQ := EXTRACT_SEQ(V_REMAIN_SEL);
 IF V_SEQ IS NULL THEN
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 IF V_FIRST_REC = TRUE THEN
 V_FIRST_REC := FALSE;
 ELSE
 CREATE_RECORD;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO := V_PLATE_NO;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR := V_VTRAN_NBR;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE := V_VTRAN_DT;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE := V_DGT_TYPE;
 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE');
 NEXT_ITEM;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRNC_NOTE := V_NOTE;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR := V_SDLVY_NBR;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT := V_SDLVY_DT;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR := V_AGENT_NBR;
 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR');
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ := V_SEQ;

 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ');
 NEXT_ITEM;

 END LOOP;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLR_DCLTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CLR_DCLTN IS
 V_TODAY DATE;
 V_DSI_RLSD NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER := NULL;
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_TODAY := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_DSI_RLSD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_RLSD');
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_HDR',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD := V_DSI_RLSD;
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC
 INTO :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_HDR',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);

 SELECT EXIT_PORT_CD
 INTO V_EXIT_PORT_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 IF V_EXIT_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM (SELECT DLMT.PORT_CD, DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H, DLMT.TRAN_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT, DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM
 WHERE DLMT.PORT_CD = DLM.PORT_CD
 AND DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND DLM.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 UNION
 SELECT DGT.PORT_CD, DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE, DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 WHERE DGT.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DGT.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR IS NOT NULL
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE IS NOT NULL
 )
 ;
 V_CNT := NVL(V_CNT, 0);

 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 INSERT INTO DCLTN_TRANS_VHCLS(PORT_CD, DCLTN_ISN, TRANS_DATE_H, TRAN_SEQ, EXIT_PORT_CD)
 SELECT DLMT.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN, DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H, DLMT.TRAN_SEQ, V_EXIT_PORT_CD
 FROM DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT, DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM
 WHERE DLMT.PORT_CD = DLM.PORT_CD
 AND DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND DLM.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 UNION
 SELECT DGT.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN, DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE, DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR, V_EXIT_PORT_CD
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 WHERE DGT.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DGT.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR IS NOT NULL
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE IS NOT NULL
 ;
/* -- a DB Trigger on DECLARATIONS will do the trick
-- #@#@# FOR CLOSING
 UPDATE VHCL_TRANSACTIONS
 SET PORT_CD_EXIT = V_EXIT_PORT_CD
 WHERE (PORT_CD, TRANS_DATE_H, TRAN_SEQ) IN
 (SELECT DLMT.PORT_CD, DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H, DLMT.TRAN_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT, DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM
 WHERE DLMT.PORT_CD = DLM.PORT_CD
 AND DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND DLM.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 UNION
 SELECT DGT.PORT_CD, DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE, DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 WHERE DGT.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DGT.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR IS NOT NULL
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE IS NOT NULL
 )
 ;

*/
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_TRANS_VHCLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 END IF;
 IF AGT.ADJ_VHCL_GOODS_FOR_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) <> 1 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 -- BECAUSE THE CHANGE IN DCLTN_HDR IS NOT REFLECTED TO THE DATABASE,
 -- WE MUST UPDATE THE DECLARATIONS TABLE BY OURSELVES
 UPDATE DECLARATIONS
 SET DCLTN_STA_CD = V_DSI_RLSD, GATE_DT = V_TODAY, VHCL_CNT = V_CNT
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 22, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE CLR_ALL_SDLVY IS

BEGIN

 EXIT WHEN CR_SDO%NOTFOUND;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ IS NULL
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) = 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(CLRD_WT)
 INTO V_DGT_SUM
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_DGT_SUM := 0;
 END;
 V_DGT_SUM := NVL(V_DGT_SUM, 0);

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(DLVRD_WT)
 INTO V_SDO_SUM
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_SDO_SUM := 0;
 END;
 V_SDO_SUM := NVL(V_SDO_SUM, 0);

 IF V_DGT_SUM <> V_SDO_SUM THEN
 UPDATE SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 SET CLRNC_DT = V_TODAY
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE CR_SDO;
END;
