ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_VSSL_BLS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_VSSL_BLS IS
 CURSOR CR_BLS IS SELECT DISTINCT B.*
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SDO, SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI, VSSL_BLS B
 WHERE SDO.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SDO.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SDI.PORT_CD = SDO.PORT_CD
 AND SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SDI.DO_NBR = SDO.DO_NBR
 AND SDI.DO_ISS_DT = SDO.DO_ISS_DT
 AND B.PORT_CD = SDI.MFST_PORT_CD
 AND B.MFST_TYPE = SDI.MFST_TYPE
 AND B.MFST_DT = SDI.MFST_DT
 AND B.MFST_NBR = SDI.MFST_NBR
 AND B.BL_SEQ = SDI.BL_SEQ
 ;
 BLS_REC VSSL_BLS%ROWTYPE;
 V_CLRD_WT NUMBER;
 V_BL_STA_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_DRY THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY') THEN
 V_BL_STA_CD := 25;
--ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_SEA THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA') THEN
--&&& END
 V_BL_STA_CD := 5;
 END IF;


 OPEN CR_BLS;
 LOOP
 FETCH CR_BLS INTO BLS_REC;
 EXIT WHEN CR_BLS%NOTFOUND;

 V_CLRD_WT := GET_VSSL_BLS_CLRD_WT(BLS_REC);

 IF V_CLRD_WT >= BLS_REC.BL_TOT_KG_WGT THEN
 UPDATE VSSL_BLS
 SET BL_STA_CD = V_BL_STA_CD
 WHERE PORT_CD = BLS_REC.PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = BLS_REC.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_DT = BLS_REC.MFST_DT
 AND MFST_NBR = BLS_REC.MFST_NBR
 AND BL_SEQ = BLS_REC.BL_SEQ
 ;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE CR_BLS;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CAN_CLR_SITEM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CAN_CLR_SITEM RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_DGT_SUM NUMBER;
 V_SDI_WT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN
 INTO V_DCLTN_ISN
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الإذن غير موجود','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END;

 IF V_DCLTN_ISN <> :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN OR V_DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الإذن غير مربوط على البيان','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 AND DGT_TYPE = 2
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) <> 0 THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الإذن مفسوح من قبل','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT DLVRD_WT
 INTO V_SDI_WT
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 AND PRCSD_ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الصنف غير موجود','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(CLRD_WT)
 INTO V_DGT_SUM
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DGT_TYPE IN (3, 5, 6)
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_DGT_SUM := 0;
 END;
 V_DGT_SUM := NVL(V_DGT_SUM, 0);

 IF V_DGT_SUM >= V_SDI_WT THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الصنف مفسوح من قبل','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;

 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
END;

 AND DO_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_SDI_SUM := 0;
 END;
 V_SDI_SUM := NVL(V_SDI_SUM, 0);

 IF V_DGT_SUM = V_SDI_SUM THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الإذن مفسوح من قبل','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;

 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CAN_CLR_ADLVY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CAN_CLR_ADLVY RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_CLRNC_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT CLRNC_TYPE, STMT_ISN
 INTO V_CLRNC_TYPE, V_DCLTN_ISN
 FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DLVY_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_NBR
 AND DLVY_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الإذن غير موجود','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END;

 IF V_DCLTN_ISN <> :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN OR V_DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الإذن غير مربوط على البيان','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;

 IF V_CLRNC_TYPE = 3 THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الإذن مفسوح من قبل','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 ELSIF V_CLRNC_TYPE <> 2 THEN
 STR.DispALERT('حالة الإذن لا تسمح بالفسح','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;

 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_VHTR_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CALL_VHTR_LOV IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'CALL_VHTR_LOV';
 RET NUMBER;
 RCOUNT NUMBER;
 CURSOR C(P_PORT NUMBER, P_SEQ NUMBER, P_DT DATE) IS SELECT PORT_CD, TRAN_SEQ, TRANS_DATE_H, TRAN_DRCTN,
 VHCL_TRAN_TYPE, PSNGR_CARG, PLATE_CTRY_CD
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VHTR
 WHERE VHTR.PORT_CD = P_PORT
 AND VHTR.TRANS_DATE_H = P_DT
 AND VHTR.TRAN_SEQ = P_SEQ
 ;
 C_REC C%ROWTYPE;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000) := NULL;
 V_RET VARCHAR(100);
 V_CHK NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(TRAN_SEQ)
 INTO RCOUNT
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND PSNGR_CARG = 2
 AND TRAN_DRCTN = 0
 AND VHCL_TRAN_TYPE IN (5, 15)
 ;

 IF RCOUNT <= 0 THEN
 Str.DispAlert('لا تحتوي القائمة على بيانات', 'ERROR');
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, ' قائمة حركة السيارات');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER,6.4);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PSNGR_CARG', TEXT_PARAMETER,2);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCRTN', TEXT_PARAMETER,0);
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_TRANS_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,); 5, 15 ???
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 10);

 CALL_FORM('LOV_VHCL_TRANS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.TRAN_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 OPEN C(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :GLOBAL.TRAN_SEQ, :GLOBAL.TRANS_DATE_H);
 FETCH C INTO C_REC;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ - لا يوجد قيد حركة لهذه اللوحة. يجب تسجيل حركة دخول', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 V_CHK := IS_VHTR_OK(C_REC.PORT_CD, C_REC.TRAN_SEQ, C_REC.TRANS_DATE_H, C_REC.TRAN_DRCTN,
 C_REC.VHCL_TRAN_TYPE, C_REC.PSNGR_CARG, C_REC.PLATE_CTRY_CD, V_MSG);
 IF V_CHK = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 IF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_MSG := V_MSG || CHR(13) || 'هل تريد الاستمرار؟';
 V_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG, 'WARNING', 1);
 IF V_RET <> ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 :VHCL_TRANS_NBR := :GLOBAL.TRAN_SEQ;
 :VHCL_TRANS_DATE := :GLOBAL.TRANS_DATE_H;
 :PLATE_NO := :GLOBAL.PLATE_NO;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PLATE_NO', ITEM_IS_VALID, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_TABS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADJ_TABS IS
 V_CUR_REC NUMBER;
 B_CLR_DATA BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 V_CUR_REC := GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS', CURRENT_RECORD);
 IF GET_RECORD_PROPERTY(V_CUR_REC, 'DCLTN_GATE_TRANS', STATUS) IN ('INSERT', 'CHANGED')
 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 B_CLR_DATA := TRUE;
 ELSE
 B_CLR_DATA := FALSE;
 END IF;

 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 1 OR :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE IS NULL THEN
 HIDE_VIEW('CG$TAB_1');

 ADJ_ADLVY_TAB_CTRLS(FALSE, B_CLR_DATA);

 ADJ_SDLVY_TAB_CTRLS(FALSE, B_CLR_DATA);

 ADJ_SITEM_TAB_CTRLS(FALSE, B_CLR_DATA);

 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 2 THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_AIR THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
--&&& END
 ADJ_ADLVY_TAB_CTRLS(TRUE, FALSE);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_1', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);

 ADJ_SDLVY_TAB_CTRLS(FALSE, B_CLR_DATA);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_2', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (DCLTN.PT_SEA, DCLTN.PT_DRY) THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
--&&& END
 ADJ_SDLVY_TAB_CTRLS(TRUE, FALSE);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_2', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);

 ADJ_ADLVY_TAB_CTRLS(FALSE, B_CLR_DATA);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_1', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;

 ADJ_SITEM_TAB_CTRLS(FALSE, B_CLR_DATA);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_3', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 SHOW_VIEW('CG$TAB_1');

 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE IN (3, 5, 6) THEN
 ADJ_SDLVY_TAB_CTRLS(TRUE, FALSE);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_2', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);

 ADJ_SITEM_TAB_CTRLS(TRUE, FALSE);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_3', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);

 ADJ_ADLVY_TAB_CTRLS(FALSE, B_CLR_DATA);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_1', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 SHOW_VIEW('CG$TAB_1');
 END IF;

 ADJ_SHRTGE_FLDS;
END;

BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.TYPE_ID := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.TYPE_NAME := NULL;
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'أنواع البيان الجمركي');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER,5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT', TEXT_PARAMETER,5);
 --IF :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID = 6841 THEN --
 IF :SYSTEM.CURRENT_FORM = 'DCLN2295' THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,1);
 END IF;

 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN_TYPE.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.TYPE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF V_TYPE_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.TYPE_ID, V_TYPE_CD);
 END IF;

 IF V_TYPE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.TYPE_NAME, V_TYPE_NAME);
 END IF;
 END IF;

END CALL_DCLTN_TYPES_LOV;

 :GLOBAL.EXIT := 0;

 IF CHECK_TIMEOUT = TRUE THEN
 DECLARE

 CheckTimer TIMER;
 BEGIN
 hWind := get_window_property(FORMS_MDI_WINDOW,WINDOW_HANDLE);

IF CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID) = TRUE THEN
IF CHECK_EDI_MSG_TIMER = TRUE THEN

 IF (V_VAR_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN IS NOT NULL) AND
 (V_VAR_VALUE > 0 AND V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN > 0) THEN

 TIMER_ID := Find_Timer('EDI_MSG');
 IF Id_Null(TIMER_ID) THEN

 ELSE
 Set_Timer(TIMER_ID,1, REPEAT);
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := Find_Timer('RETURN_EDI_MSG');
 IF Id_Null(TIMER_ID) THEN

 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
END IF;
END IF;
 :GLOBAL.G_TIME_OUT := 0;
 :GLOBAL.TIMER := 0;
 :global.item_name := NULL;

SYS.DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.set_module (NVL(:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME,'NEBRAS')||' '||nvl(:GLOBAL.current_ver,' '), NULL);

 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-F9
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
 VIS VARCHAR2(200);
 V_FUN VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 VIS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE);
 V_FUN := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FUN_BUT',VISIBLE);

 IF VIS = 'TRUE' THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ELSE
 IF V_FUN = 'TRUE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');

 TMPLT.Populate_Functions;
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := TRUE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 1;
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-HELP
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := '';
 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';
 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$WHEN_NEW_BLOCK_INSTANCE */
/* ensure the current canvas is correctly coordinated */
BEGIN
 CGBS$.NEW_BLOCK( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE);
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-CLEAR-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_CLEAR_DETAILS */
/* clear all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 IF (FORM_FAILURE AND :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION IN ('MOUSE', 'DUPLICATE_RECORD')) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK = :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) THEN
 CGBS$.CLEAR_MASTER_DETAIL( :SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK, :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION );
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_POPULATE_DETAILS */
/* query all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 CGBS$.QUERY_DETAILS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CQUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CQUERY_FRM */
/* Check if query is allowed to avoid unnecessary coordination */
BEGIN
 IF (get_block_property( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'FALSE') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(37, 'Query not allowed in this block'), 'E', 'OFG', 37);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CGBS$.DO_KEYQRY( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK, 'COUNT_QUERY', :SYSTEM.MODE);
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CLRREC */
/* Avoid clearing details if current row is new and invalid */
BEGIN
 IF ( CGBS2$.IS_RECORD_DIRTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.BLOCK_STATUS = 'CHANGED' OR CGBS2$.IS_COMMIT_NEEDED( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK ) ) THEN
 CGBS2$.DO_COMMIT_DIALOGUE;
 END IF;
 clear_record;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTKEY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$DISABLE_NXTKEY */
/* Disable KEY-NXTKEY for the whole form */
BEGIN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(30, 'Key not valid in this context'), 'E', 'OFG', 30);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE_QUERY_MODE */
/* This changes the mode of block synchronization so that if it is */
/* currently ON, then it is changed to OFF, and vice-versa. */
/* It also queries the dependent blocks as appropriate for the */
/* new mode. */
BEGIN
 CGBS$TOGGLE( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRFRM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGGN$KEY_CLRFRM */
/* Perform the key's standard functionality */
BEGIN
 clear_form;
 IF :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'CHANGED' THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

/* CGCF$PERFORM_STARTUP */
/* execute the when-new-form-instance code that was created by forms generator */
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
END;
